column4: Aravind Kumar Foundation  (Incorporation)
to advise and assist all communities in Sri lanka to
live in peace and harmony;
to establish information technology centers for the
advancement of scientific studies;
to implement social mobilization programmes and
educational  and  training  programmes  for  the
development of children and women;
to  assist  affected  people  in  disaster  situations  to
uplift their life style and providing legal assistance
for needy vulnerable people;
to  grant  scholarships  to  needy  school  children  to
enable them to continue their education;
to  assist  in  the  development  of  educational,
religious,  cultural,  aesthetic  and  sports  facilities
without any reference to race, religion or cast;
to  promote  ethics  and  culture,  create  necessary
resources and maintain;
to take necessary steps to promote artistic creations,
sport  skills  and  technical  knowledge  of  school
leavers and set up vocational training centers ; and
to liaise and co-ordinate with other local or foreign
institutions when have similar objects.
